sources.title: Kanokwan Wongchan and Satit Saejung, On the Strong Convergence of Viscosity Approximation Process for Quasinonexpansive Mappings in Hilbert Spaces
sources.inspection: Statement read in original PDF and page visually checked; surrounding extracted proof inspected
sources.scope: Antecedent for viscosity convergence with a strongly quasinonexpansive map and demiclosed residual; does not itself instantiate our composite or input perturbation.

sources.title: Koji Aoyama and Fumiaki Kohsaka, Viscosity approximation process for a sequence of quasinonexpansive mappings
sources.inspection: Statement read in original PDF and page visually checked; surrounding extracted proof inspected
sources.scope: Corroborating fixed-map viscosity result within a broader sequence framework; our perturbed iteration is proved separately.

relationship: Established mathematical antecedents; no novelty claim and no validation of all claims in either paper
